nameOrigin: to heat/fry (referring to cooking and its Fire type)

pokedexEntries.bk: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

pokedexEntries.wh: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600° F.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.
